title: Agent scorecard table rendering

claims.text: scorecard fetches scorecard_get through scoreResult and verifies the returned head.
renderScorecard filters groups by seat and memory arm and renders runs, successes, unknown costs, mean cost and mean duration columns.
Missing data renders the grouped-by-seat-arm note and empty groups render the no-measurements note.

triggers: seat or arm filter with no rows

decision.rule: Change here when scorecard fetching, filtering or table columns need to change.
decision.failure: Scorecards show wrong seats or arms, averages use wrong groups, or empty data renders a blank table.

questions.q: Where does scorecard fetch and verify the scorecard head?
Where should I change the seat and memory-arm filters or table columns?
Where can I debug why scorecard rows disappear under filters?
